```{r}
# Load required packages
library(forestplot)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(Cairo)

# Define the outcome names and their readable labels
outcomes <- c("phlth", "pinactive", "mhlth", "asthma", "checkup")
outcome_labels <- c(
  "phlth" = "Poor physical health",
  "pinactive" = "Physical inactivity", 
  "mhlth" = "Poor mental health",
  "asthma" = "Current asthma",
  "checkup" = "Routine health checkup"
)

# Initialize empty data frame to store all results
all_data <- data.frame()

# Read data from each CSV file
for(outcome in outcomes) {
  filename <- paste0("results_final_", outcome, ".csv")
  
  # Check if file exists
  if(file.exists(filename)) {
    # Read the CSV file
    temp_data <- read.csv(filename, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Add to combined dataset
    all_data <- rbind(all_data, temp_data)
    cat("Loaded data from:", filename, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Warning: File not found:", filename, "\n")
  }
}

# Check if we have any data
if(nrow(all_data) == 0) {
  stop("No data files were found or loaded. Please check that your CSV files are in the working directory.")
}

# Filter for cluster effects only (cluster2 and cluster3)
cluster_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(term %in% c("cluster_2", "cluster_3")) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_label = outcome_labels[outcome],
    # Rename clusters
    cluster_label = case_when(
      term == "cluster_2" ~ "Environmental improvement",
      term == "cluster_3" ~ "Environmental gentrification",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    # Create formatted columns for display using posterior mean and credible intervals
    est_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", posterior_mean, cred_low, cred_high)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(outcome, outcomes), term)  # Order by the specified outcome order

# Check if we have cluster data
if(nrow(cluster_data) == 0) {
  stop("No cluster2 or cluster3 terms found in the data. Please check your CSV files.")
}

# Display summary of loaded data
cat("\nData summary:\n")
print(table(cluster_data$outcome, cluster_data$term))

# Setup forestplot data structures
left_text <- list()
means <- list()
lower_limits <- list()
upper_limits <- list()
right_text <- list()
is_summary_row <- list()

row_count <- 1

# Add header row
left_text[[row_count]] <- c("Health-Relevant Endpoint")
means[[row_count]] <- NA
lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
right_text[[row_count]] <- c("Effect (95% CI)")
is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- TRUE
row_count <- row_count + 1

# Process each health outcome
for (i in 1:length(outcomes)) {
  outcome <- outcomes[i]
  outcome_data <- cluster_data[cluster_data$outcome == outcome, ]
  
  # Skip if no data for this outcome
  if(nrow(outcome_data) == 0) {
    cat("Warning: No cluster data found for outcome:", outcome, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Add outcome header
  left_text[[row_count]] <- c(outcome_labels[outcome])
  means[[row_count]] <- NA
  lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
  upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
  right_text[[row_count]] <- c("")
  is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- TRUE
  row_count <- row_count + 1
  
  # Add cluster rows
  for (j in 1:nrow(outcome_data)) {
    row <- outcome_data[j, ]
    left_text[[row_count]] <- c(paste0("  ", row$cluster_label))
    means[[row_count]] <- row$posterior_mean
    lower_limits[[row_count]] <- row$cred_low
    upper_limits[[row_count]] <- row$cred_high
    right_text[[row_count]] <- c(row$est_ci)
    is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- FALSE
    row_count <- row_count + 1
  }
  
  # Add a blank row if not the last outcome
  if (i < length(outcomes)) {
    left_text[[row_count]] <- c("")
    means[[row_count]] <- NA
    lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
    upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
    right_text[[row_count]] <- c("")
    is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- FALSE
    row_count <- row_count + 1
  }
}

# Convert lists to vectors/matrices
left_text <- do.call(rbind, left_text)
means <- unlist(means)
lower_limits <- unlist(lower_limits)
upper_limits <- unlist(upper_limits)
right_text <- do.call(rbind, right_text)
is_summary_row <- unlist(is_summary_row)

# Combine left and right text with empty column for the graph
tabletext <- cbind(left_text, 
                   matrix("", nrow=nrow(left_text), ncol=1),  # Empty column for the graph
                   right_text)

# Generate horizontal line positions - only after header and between outcome groups
hline_positions <- c()
hline_positions[length(hline_positions) + 1] <- 2  # Line after header

# Calculate line positions dynamically based on actual data
current_row <- 2  # Start after header
outcomes_with_data <- unique(cluster_data$outcome)
outcomes_with_data <- outcomes_with_data[order(match(outcomes_with_data, outcomes))]

for (i in 1:length(outcomes_with_data)) {
  outcome <- outcomes_with_data[i]
  outcome_data <- cluster_data[cluster_data$outcome == outcome, ]
  
  # Count rows in this outcome group (1 header + number of clusters + 1 blank row except last group)
  rows_in_group <- 1 + nrow(outcome_data)  # 1 header + cluster rows
  if (i < length(outcomes_with_data)) rows_in_group <- rows_in_group + 1  # Add blank row
  
  # Add line after the entire outcome group
  current_row <- current_row + rows_in_group
  if (i < length(outcomes_with_data)) {  # Don't add line after the very last group
    hline_positions[length(hline_positions) + 1] <- current_row
  }
}

# Create horizontal lines
hrzl_lines <- lapply(hline_positions, function(pos) {
  gpar(lwd = 1)
})
names(hrzl_lines) <- as.character(hline_positions)

# Determine appropriate axis range based on data
data_range <- range(c(lower_limits, upper_limits), na.rm = TRUE)
axis_min <- floor(data_range[1] * 2) / 2  # Round down to nearest 0.5
axis_max <- ceiling(data_range[2] * 2) / 2  # Round up to nearest 0.5
tick_seq <- seq(axis_min, axis_max, 0.5)

# Create the forest plot
forestplot(
  tabletext,
  means,
  lower_limits,
  upper_limits,
  is.summary = is_summary_row,
  graph.pos = 2,
  txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
    label = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    ticks = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    xlab = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    title = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.9, fontfamily = "Arial")
  ),
  col = fpColors(
    box = "black",
    line = "black",
    summary = "black"
  ),
  boxsize = 0.2,
  lineheight = unit(6, "mm"),
  graphwidth = unit(120, "mm"),
  lwd.ci = 1,
  ci.vertices = TRUE,
  ci.vertices.height = 0.1,
  xlab = "Percentage Point Difference",
  zero = 0,
  grid = TRUE,
  lty.zero = 2,
  xticks = tick_seq,
  clip = c(axis_min, axis_max),
  hrzl_lines = hrzl_lines,
  align = c("l", "c", "r"),
  colgap = unit(5, "mm"),
  mar = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")
)

# Save as TIFF file
tiff_file <- "forest_plot_health_endpoints_imputations.tiff"
tiff(tiff_file,
     width = 10, height = 7,
     units = "in",
     compression = "lzw",
     res = 600,
     type = "cairo")

# Recreate the forest plot for saving
forestplot(
  tabletext,
  means,
  lower_limits,
  upper_limits,
  is.summary = is_summary_row,
  graph.pos = 2,
  txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
    label = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    ticks = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    xlab = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    title = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.9, fontfamily = "Arial")
  ),
  col = fpColors(
    box = "black",
    line = "black",
    summary = "black"
  ),
  boxsize = 0.2,
  lineheight = unit(6, "mm"),
  graphwidth = unit(120, "mm"),
  lwd.ci = 1,
  ci.vertices = TRUE,
  ci.vertices.height = 0.1,
  xlab = "Percentage Point Difference",
  zero = 0,
  grid = TRUE,
  lty.zero = 2,
  xticks = tick_seq,
  clip = c(axis_min, axis_max),
  hrzl_lines = hrzl_lines,
  align = c("l", "c", "r"),
  title = "Forest Plot of Environmental Effects by Health Endpoint",
  colgap = unit(5, "mm"),
  mar = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")
)

dev.off()
cat("Forest plot saved as", tiff_file, "\n")

# Print summary statistics
cat("\nSummary of effects:\n")
summary_stats <- cluster_data %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome_label, cluster_label, posterior_mean, cred_low, cred_high, credible_excludes_zero) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label, cluster_label)
print(summary_stats)
```

POINT ESTIMATE FOREST PLOT
```{r}
# Load required packages
library(forestplot)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(Cairo)

# Read in the data
data <- data.frame(
  outcome = c("prev_abs_change_phlth", "prev_abs_change_phlth", 
              "prev_abs_change_pinactive", "prev_abs_change_pinactive",
              "prev_abs_change_mhlth", "prev_abs_change_mhlth",
              "prev_abs_change_asthma", "prev_abs_change_asthma",
              "prev_abs_change_checkup", "prev_abs_change_checkup"),
  cluster_term = c("cluster2", "cluster3", "cluster2", "cluster3", 
                  "cluster2", "cluster3", "cluster2", "cluster3",
                  "cluster2", "cluster3"),
  estimate = c(0.120924921, 0.029255481, 0.088113025, -0.513648223,
               0.051105088, -0.009210277, 0.042270808, -0.047390341,
               0.011362223, -0.288148826),
  std_error = c(0.091646213, 0.134813862, 0.17479646, 0.255425099,
                0.081043873, 0.119029573, 0.032076693, 0.046991226,
                0.047023382, 0.069982513),
  p_value = c(0.187010241, 0.828203301, 0.614198629, 0.044330275,
              0.528311604, 0.938322796, 0.187569122, 0.313217659,
              0.809067486, 3.83E-05)
)

# Create a mapping for outcome names
outcome_labels <- c(
  "prev_abs_change_phlth" = "Poor physical health",
  "prev_abs_change_pinactive" = "Physical inactivity",
  "prev_abs_change_mhlth" = "Poor mental health",
  "prev_abs_change_asthma" = "Current asthma",
  "prev_abs_change_checkup" = "Routine health checkup"
)

# Add a nicer outcome label and calculate CI
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_label = outcome_labels[outcome],
    # Rename clusters and remove the word "cluster" as requested
    cluster_label = ifelse(cluster_term == "cluster2", 
                          "Environmental improvement", 
                          "Environmental gentrification"),
    # Calculate lower and upper bounds of 95% CI
    lower = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
    upper = estimate + 1.96 * std_error,
    # Create formatted columns for display with 2 decimal places
    est_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", estimate, lower, upper)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, cluster_term)

# Get unique outcomes in order for the plot
outcomes_order <- c("prev_abs_change_phlth", "prev_abs_change_pinactive", 
                   "prev_abs_change_mhlth", "prev_abs_change_asthma", 
                   "prev_abs_change_checkup")

# Setup forestplot data structures
left_text <- list()
means <- list()
lower_limits <- list()
upper_limits <- list()
right_text <- list()
is_summary_row <- list()

row_count <- 1

# Add header row
left_text[[row_count]] <- c("Health-Relevant Endpoint")  # Changed from "Health Outcome"
means[[row_count]] <- NA
lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
right_text[[row_count]] <- c("Effect (95% CI)")  # Removed significance column
is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- TRUE
row_count <- row_count + 1

# Process each health outcome
for (i in 1:length(outcomes_order)) {
  outcome <- outcomes_order[i]
  outcome_data <- data[data$outcome == outcome, ]
  
  # Add outcome header
  left_text[[row_count]] <- c(outcome_labels[outcome])
  means[[row_count]] <- NA
  lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
  upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
  right_text[[row_count]] <- c("")  # Only one column needed now
  is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- TRUE
  row_count <- row_count + 1
  
  # Add cluster rows
  for (j in 1:nrow(outcome_data)) {
    row <- outcome_data[j, ]
    left_text[[row_count]] <- c(paste0("  ", row$cluster_label))
    means[[row_count]] <- row$estimate
    lower_limits[[row_count]] <- row$lower
    upper_limits[[row_count]] <- row$upper
    right_text[[row_count]] <- c(row$est_ci)  # Only one column needed now
    is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- FALSE
    row_count <- row_count + 1
  }
  
  # Add a blank row if not the last outcome
  if (i < length(outcomes_order)) {
    left_text[[row_count]] <- c("")
    means[[row_count]] <- NA
    lower_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
    upper_limits[[row_count]] <- NA
    right_text[[row_count]] <- c("")  # Only one column needed now
    is_summary_row[[row_count]] <- FALSE
    row_count <- row_count + 1
  }
}

# Convert lists to vectors/matrices
left_text <- do.call(rbind, left_text)
means <- unlist(means)
lower_limits <- unlist(lower_limits)
upper_limits <- unlist(upper_limits)
right_text <- do.call(rbind, right_text)
is_summary_row <- unlist(is_summary_row)

# Combine left and right text with empty column for the graph
tabletext <- cbind(left_text, 
                   matrix("", nrow=nrow(left_text), ncol=1),  # Empty column for the graph
                   right_text)

# Generate horizontal line positions - only after header and between outcome groups
hline_positions <- c()
hline_positions[length(hline_positions) + 1] <- 2  # Line after header

# For each outcome, add a line only after the whole outcome group
current_row <- 2  # Start after header
for (i in 1:length(outcomes_order)) {
  # Count rows in this outcome group (1 header + 2 clusters + 1 blank row except last group)
  rows_in_group <- 3  # 1 header + 2 clusters
  if (i < length(outcomes_order)) rows_in_group <- rows_in_group + 1  # Add blank row
  
  # Add line after the entire outcome group
  current_row <- current_row + rows_in_group
  if (i < length(outcomes_order)) {  # Don't add line after the very last group
    hline_positions[length(hline_positions) + 1] <- current_row
  }
}

# Create horizontal lines
hrzl_lines <- lapply(hline_positions, function(pos) {
  gpar(lwd = 1)
})
names(hrzl_lines) <- as.character(hline_positions)

# Function to create the forest plot - we'll define it first so we can reuse it
create_forest_plot <- function() {
  forestplot(
    tabletext,
    means,
    lower_limits,
    upper_limits,
    is.summary = is_summary_row,
    graph.pos = 2,
    txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
      label = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      ticks = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      xlab = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
      title = gpar(fontface = "plain", cex = 0.9, fontfamily = "Arial")
    ),
    col = fpColors(
      box = "black",
      line = "black",
      summary = "black"
    ),
    boxsize = 0.2,
    lineheight = unit(6, "mm"),
    graphwidth = unit(120, "mm"),
    lwd.ci = 1,
    ci.vertices = TRUE,
    ci.vertices.height = 0.1,
    xlab = "Percentage Point Difference",
    zero = 0,
    grid = TRUE,
    lty.zero = 2,
    xticks = seq(-0.8, 0.8, 0.2),
    clip = c(-0.8, 0.8),
    hrzl_lines = hrzl_lines,
    align = c("l", "c", "r"),
    colgap = unit(5, "mm"),
    mar = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm")
  )
}

# 1. Save as TIFF file
tiff_file <- "forest_plot_health_endpoints.tiff"
tiff(tiff_file,
     width = 10, height = 7, # Dimensions in inches
     units = "in",
     compression = "lzw", # LZW compression for smaller file size
     res = 600, # Resolution in dpi (600 dpi is publication quality)
     type = "cairo") # Use Cairo for better quality

create_forest_plot()
dev.off()
cat("Forest plot saved as", tiff_file, "\n")

# 2. Save as PDF file
pdf_file <- "forest_plot_health_endpoints.pdf"
pdf(pdf_file,
    width = 8, height = 10, # Dimensions in inches
    useDingbats = FALSE) # Avoid font issues

create_forest_plot()
dev.off()
cat("Forest plot saved as", pdf_file, "\n")

# 3. Display the plot in the R viewer (optional)
create_forest_plot()
```

```{r}
nyct2010wi <- st_read("nybb.shp")  
create_figure_1 <- function(data, spatial_data, nyct2010wi) {
  # Define colors
  cluster_colors <- c("#e4c988", "#687c24", "#7e4708")
  
  # Cluster labels
  cluster_labels <- c(
    "1" = "Cluster 1: No environmental gentrification",
    "2" = "Cluster 2: Environmental improvement, no gentrification",
    "3" = "Cluster 3: Environmental gentrification"
  )
  
  # Clip spatial data to NYC boundaries
  # Convert both to the same CRS if needed
  if (st_crs(spatial_data) != st_crs(nyct2010wi)) {
    spatial_data <- st_transform(spatial_data, st_crs(nyct2010wi))
  }
  
  # Create a union of NYC boundaries to use for clipping
  nyc_boundary <- st_union(nyct2010wi)
  
  # Clip spatial data to NYC boundary
  spatial_data <- st_intersection(spatial_data, nyc_boundary)
  
  # Identify areas with missing cluster data (NA)
  missing_data <- spatial_data %>%
    filter(is.na(cluster))
  
  # Find bounding box where data exists to crop the map
  data_exists <- spatial_data %>% filter(!is.na(cluster))
  
  # Create a buffer around data areas
  buffered_data_bbox <- st_bbox(data_exists) + c(-0.01, -0.01, 0.01, 0.01)
  
  # Figure 1a: K-means clustering results 
  p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = env_improvement, y = score_0.5, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.28) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cluster_colors,
      labels = cluster_labels
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "(a) K-means Clustering Results",  
      x = "Environmental Improvement Score",
      y = "Gentrification Score",
      color = "Cluster Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # Figure 1b: Spatial map with background mask for grid lines
  p2 <- ggplot() +
    # Create a white background for NYC area to hide grid lines only behind the map
    # This is drawn first so grid lines will still appear outside the NYC boundary
    geom_sf(data = nyc_boundary, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    # Add non-study areas with light grey fill
    geom_sf(data = missing_data, fill = "#F0F0F0", color = "grey", size = 0.1) +
    # Add areas with cluster data
    geom_sf(data = spatial_data %>% filter(!is.na(cluster)), 
            aes(fill = cluster), color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1) +
    # Redraw NYC borders on top to ensure clean edges
    geom_sf(data = nyct2010wi, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = cluster_colors,
      labels = cluster_labels
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(buffered_data_bbox["xmin"], buffered_data_bbox["xmax"]), 
             ylim = c(buffered_data_bbox["ymin"], buffered_data_bbox["ymax"])) +
    labs(
      title = "(b) Spatial Distribution of Clusters",
      fill = "Cluster Type"
    ) +
    # Keep grid lines but ensure they're behind all map elements
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      # Make grid lines lighter so they're visible outside the map but not distracting
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#DDDDDD", size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#EEEEEE", size = 0.1)
    )
  
# Create a common legend for both plots with proper spacing and sizing
common_legend <- ggpubr::get_legend(
  ggplot(data, aes(x = env_improvement, y = score_0.5, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +  # Slightly reduced point size (was 4)
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cluster_colors,
      labels = cluster_labels,
      name = NULL  
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.0, "cm"),  # Reduced key size (was 1.5)
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Reduced text size (was 12)
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm"),  # Reduced horizontal spacing (was 0.5)
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),  # Control spacing around legend box
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 0, l = 5, unit = "pt"),  # Reduced margins
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "pt"),  # Reduced top margin
      legend.direction = "horizontal",  # Ensure horizontal layout
      legend.box.just = "center"  # Center the legend box
    )
)
  
  # Combine plots using gridExtra with a shared legend at the bottom
  combined_plot <- gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
      p1, p2, 
      ncol = 2,
      top = grid::textGrob("Figure 1: K-means Clustering Analysis",
                          gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
    ),
    common_legend,
    heights = c(10, 1),
    ncol = 1
  )
  
  return(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r}
# Modified version of create_residual_map function with pale yellow middle color
create_residual_map <- function(residuals_df, spatial_data, outcome, 
                               title = NULL, save_path = NULL) {
  # Merge residuals with spatial data
  map_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(residuals_df, by = "tractid")
  
  # Convert residuals to standard deviation units
  map_data <- map_data %>%
    mutate(std_residual = (residual - mean(residual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Calculate range to ensure all values are covered
  min_val <- floor(min(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  max_val <- ceiling(max(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Create 5 equally spaced breaks between min and max
  breaks <- seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = 6)
  
  # Create labels for these groups
  sd_labels <- character(5)
  for(i in 1:5) {
    if(i == 1) {
      # First group uses closed bracket on both sides
      sd_labels[i] <- sprintf("[%.1f,%.1f]", breaks[i], breaks[i+1])
    } else {
      # Other groups use open bracket on left side
      sd_labels[i] <- sprintf("(%.1f,%.1f]", breaks[i], breaks[i+1])
    }
  }
  
  # Create custom orange to blue palette with pale yellow in the middle (5 colors)
  color_palette <- c("#FD8D3C", "#FDBE85", "#FFFDE4", "#9ECAE1", "#3182BD")
  
  # Create title if not provided
  if(is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste("Spatial Residuals for", toupper(outcome))
  }
  
  # Create categories for map coloring
  map_data <- map_data %>%
    mutate(residual_cat = case_when(
      std_residual >= breaks[1] & std_residual <= breaks[2] ~ sd_labels[1],
      std_residual > breaks[2] & std_residual <= breaks[3] ~ sd_labels[2],
      std_residual > breaks[3] & std_residual <= breaks[4] ~ sd_labels[3],
      std_residual > breaks[4] & std_residual <= breaks[5] ~ sd_labels[4],
      std_residual > breaks[5] & std_residual <= breaks[6] ~ sd_labels[5],
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"  # Catch any unexpected values
    ))
  
  # Ensure factor levels are ordered correctly for legend
  map_data$residual_cat <- factor(map_data$residual_cat, levels = sd_labels)
  
  # Create map with white background and fixed aspect ratio
  p <- ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = residual_cat, geometry = geometry), 
            color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Residuals\n(Standard Deviations)", 
      values = setNames(color_palette, sd_labels),
      drop = FALSE  # Ensure all legend items appear even if no data
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    # Fix the aspect ratio to avoid stretching
    coord_sf(datum = NA)  # This helps with the stretching issue
  
  # Save if path is provided
  if(!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Also update the custom version
create_residual_map_custom <- function(residuals_df, spatial_data, outcome, 
                                      custom_breaks = NULL,
                                      custom_colors = NULL,
                                      title = NULL, save_path = NULL) {
  # Merge residuals with spatial data
  map_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(residuals_df, by = "tractid")
  
  # Convert residuals to standard deviation units
  map_data <- map_data %>%
    mutate(std_residual = (residual - mean(residual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Calculate range or use custom breaks
  if(is.null(custom_breaks)) {
    # Calculate range to ensure all values are covered
    min_val <- floor(min(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
    max_val <- ceiling(max(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Create 5 equally spaced breaks between min and max
    breaks <- seq(min_val, max_val, length.out = 6)
  } else {
    breaks <- custom_breaks
  }
  
  # Create labels for these groups
  n_groups <- length(breaks) - 1
  custom_labels <- character(n_groups)
  for(i in 1:n_groups) {
    if(i == 1) {
      # First group uses closed bracket on both sides
      custom_labels[i] <- sprintf("[%.1f,%.1f]", breaks[i], breaks[i+1])
    } else {
      # Other groups use open bracket on left side
      custom_labels[i] <- sprintf("(%.1f,%.1f]", breaks[i], breaks[i+1])
    }
  }
  
  # Default colors using orange to blue palette with pale yellow middle
  if(is.null(custom_colors)) {
    if(n_groups == 5) {
      custom_colors <- c("#FD8D3C", "#FDBE85", "#FFFDE4", "#9ECAE1", "#3182BD")
    } else if(n_groups == 4) {
      custom_colors <- c("#FD8D3C", "#FDBE85", "#FFFDE4", "#3182BD")
    } else {
      # For other number of groups, create a gradient
      custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FD8D3C", "#FFFDE4", "#3182BD"))(n_groups)
    }
  }
  
  # Create title if not provided
  if(is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste("Spatial Residuals for", toupper(outcome))
  }
  
  # Create categories based on breaks
  map_data$residual_cat <- cut(map_data$std_residual, 
                              breaks = breaks,
                              labels = custom_labels,
                              include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  # Create map with white background and fixed aspect ratio
  p <- ggplot(map_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = residual_cat, geometry = geometry), 
            color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Residuals\n(Standard Deviations)", 
      values = setNames(custom_colors, custom_labels),
      drop = FALSE  # Ensure all legend items appear even if no data
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    # Fix the aspect ratio
    coord_sf(datum = NA)
  
  # Save if path is provided
  if(!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Update the advanced map function as well
create_advanced_residual_map <- function(residuals_df, spatial_data, outcome, 
                                        county_boundaries = NULL, 
                                        highlight_tracts = NULL,
                                        title = NULL, save_path = NULL) {
  # Merge residuals with spatial data
  map_data <- spatial_data %>%
    left_join(residuals_df, by = "tractid")
  
  # Create title if not provided
  if(is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste("Spatial Residuals for", toupper(outcome))
  }
  
  # Convert to standard deviations
  map_data <- map_data %>%
    mutate(std_residual = (residual - mean(residual, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Calculate range for color scale
  min_val <- floor(min(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  max_val <- ceiling(max(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Create base map with white background using continuous scale with fixed limits
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = map_data, aes(fill = std_residual, geometry = geometry), 
            color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      name = "Residual\n(Standard Deviations)", 
      colors = c("#FD8D3C", "#FDBE85", "#FFFDE4", "#9ECAE1", "#3182BD"),
      limits = c(min_val, max_val)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 10, barheight = 0.5))
  
  # Add county boundaries if provided
  if(!is.null(county_boundaries)) {
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = county_boundaries, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5)
  }
  
  # Highlight specific tracts if provided
  if(!is.null(highlight_tracts)) {
    highlight_data <- spatial_data %>%
      filter(tractid %in% highlight_tracts)
    
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = highlight_data, fill = NA, color = "purple", size = 1)
  }
  
  # Finalize map styling with white background and fixed aspect ratio
  p <- p + theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = "Spatial residuals from SCAT GAM model with MRF smoothing") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    # Fix the aspect ratio
    coord_sf(datum = NA)
  
  # Save if path is provided
  if(!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

)
```

```{r}
# Custom function to generate spatial residual maps for NYC
# Modified for all_simulations as a list of 1000 dataframes, each containing all outcomes
generate_nyc_residual_maps <- function(nyc_tracts, 
                                      all_simulations, 
                                      outcomes,
                                      geoid_col_tracts = "GEOID", # Column in nyc_tracts to match with tractid
                                      save_dir = "./improved_residual_maps") {
  
  # Create the save directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {
    dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Ensure proper CRS for nyc_tracts
  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(nyc_tracts))) {
    nyc_tracts <- sf::st_set_crs(nyc_tracts, 4326)
  }
  
  # Transform to WGS84 for consistent mapping
  nyc_tracts <- sf::st_transform(nyc_tracts, 4326)
  
  # Create a list to store all maps
  all_maps <- list()
  
  # Loop through each outcome
  for (outcome in outcomes) {
    cat("Processing outcome:", outcome, "\n")
    
    # Construct full column names for observed and expected values
    observed_col <- paste0("sim_prev_abs_change_", outcome)
    expected_col <- paste0("expected_", outcome)  # Adjust if your expected column naming is different
    
    # Check if the expected columns exist in the first dataframe (assuming all have same structure)
    if (length(all_simulations) > 0) {
      first_df <- all_simulations[[1]]
      
      if (!(observed_col %in% colnames(first_df))) {
        warning("Observed column ", observed_col, " not found in simulation dataframes. Skipping.")
        next
      }
      
      # For expected, we'll either use the expected_* column if it exists, or calculate the mean across simulations
      has_expected_col <- expected_col %in% colnames(first_df)
      if (!has_expected_col) {
        cat("Expected column not found. Will calculate mean across all simulations.\n")
      }
    } else {
      warning("all_simulations is empty. Skipping.")
      next
    }
    
    # Extract tractids from the first dataframe
    tractids <- first_df$tractid
    
    # Create aggregation dataframe with tractid
    agg_data <- data.frame(tractid = tractids)
    
    # Extract observed values from each simulation for this outcome
    observed_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(tractids), ncol = length(all_simulations))
    
    for (i in 1:length(all_simulations)) {
      sim_df <- all_simulations[[i]]
      
      # Match tractids to ensure correct alignment
      idx <- match(tractids, sim_df$tractid)
      
      # Extract values for this outcome
      observed_values[, i] <- sim_df[idx, observed_col]
    }
    
    # Calculate mean observed value across all simulations for each tract
    agg_data$observed <- rowMeans(observed_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Get or calculate expected values
    if (has_expected_col) {
      # If expected column exists, use it from the first simulation
      agg_data$expected <- first_df[match(tractids, first_df$tractid), expected_col]
    } else {
      # Otherwise, calculate the global mean as the expected value
      agg_data$expected <- mean(agg_data$observed, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Calculate residuals
    agg_data$residual <- agg_data$observed - agg_data$expected
    
    # Check for NAs in residuals
    if (any(is.na(agg_data$residual))) {
      cat("Warning: NAs found in residuals. Count:", sum(is.na(agg_data$residual)), "\n")
    }
    
    # Create a mapping between tractid and GEOID (or GEOID10) if needed
    if (geoid_col_tracts != "tractid" && !("tractid" %in% colnames(nyc_tracts))) {
      # If nyc_tracts doesn't have tractid, we need to ensure it can join with sim_data
      cat("Creating temporary 'tractid' column from", geoid_col_tracts, "for joining\n")
      nyc_tracts$tractid <- nyc_tracts[[geoid_col_tracts]]
    }
    
    # Print summary of tractids for debugging
    cat("Sample aggregated tractids:", head(agg_data$tractid), "\n")
    cat("Sample nyc_tracts tractids (or mapped column):", 
        ifelse("tractid" %in% colnames(nyc_tracts), 
               paste(head(nyc_tracts$tractid), collapse=", "),
               paste(head(nyc_tracts[[geoid_col_tracts]]), collapse=", ")), "\n")
    
    # Create a temporary copy of nyc_tracts for this outcome
    map_data <- nyc_tracts
    
    # Join with agg_data to get residuals
    if ("tractid" %in% colnames(map_data)) {
      map_data$residual <- NA # Initialize with NA
      map_data$residual[match(agg_data$tractid, map_data$tractid)] <- agg_data$residual
    } else {
      # Join based on geoid_col_tracts matching tractid in agg_data
      map_data$residual <- NA # Initialize with NA
      map_data$residual[match(agg_data$tractid, map_data[[geoid_col_tracts]])] <- agg_data$residual
    }
    
    # Print summary after joining to check for NAs
    cat("Summary of residuals after joining:\n")
    print(summary(map_data$residual))
    
    # Skip this outcome if all residuals are NA
    if (all(is.na(map_data$residual))) {
      warning("All residuals are NA for outcome ", outcome, ". Skipping.")
      next
    }
    
    # Calculate standardized residuals (z-scores)
    map_data$std_residual <- (map_data$residual - mean(map_data$residual, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                             sd(map_data$residual, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate min and max for better breaks
    min_val <- floor(min(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
    max_val <- ceiling(max(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Create symmetric breaks centered at 0
    max_abs <- max(abs(min_val), abs(max_val))
    breaks <- c(-max_abs, -max_abs/2, 0, max_abs/2, max_abs)
    
    # Create labels for the categories
    sd_labels <- character(length(breaks) - 1)
    for (i in 1:(length(breaks) - 1)) {
      if (i == 1) {
        sd_labels[i] <- sprintf("[%.1f,%.1f]", breaks[i], breaks[i+1])
      } else {
        sd_labels[i] <- sprintf("(%.1f,%.1f]", breaks[i], breaks[i+1])
      }
    }
    
    # Create custom orange to blue palette with pale yellow in the middle
    color_palette <- c("#FD8D3C", "#FDBE85", "#FFFDE4", "#9ECAE1", "#3182BD")
    
    # Create categories for coloring
    map_data$residual_cat <- cut(map_data$std_residual, 
                               breaks = breaks,
                               labels = sd_labels,
                               include.lowest = TRUE)
    
    # Create the map
    title <- paste("Spatial Residuals for", toupper(outcome))
    
    map <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data = map_data, 
                     ggplot2::aes(fill = residual_cat), 
                     color = "white", size = 0.1) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        name = "Residuals\n(Standard Deviations)", 
        values = setNames(color_palette, sd_labels),
        drop = FALSE,
        na.value = "gray80"  # Color for NA values
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = title,
                  subtitle = "Standardized by Standard Deviation") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank()
      ) +
      # Fix the aspect ratio to avoid stretching
      ggplot2::coord_sf(datum = NA)
    
    # Add the map to the list
    all_maps[[outcome]] <- map
    
    # Save the map to a file
    map_filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("residual_map_", outcome, ".png"))
    ggplot2::ggsave(map_filename, map, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    
    # Create an interactive map using tmap
    tmap_mode <- tmap::tmap_mode("view")
    
    # Create the interactive map
    interactive_map <- tmap::tm_shape(map_data) +
      tmap::tm_polygons("std_residual", 
                    style = "fisher",
                    n = 5,
                    palette = color_palette,
                    title = "Residuals (SD)",
                    colorNA = "gray80") +
      tmap::tm_layout(title = paste("Spatial Residuals for", outcome))
    
    # Save interactive map
    interactive_filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("interactive_map_", outcome, ".html"))
    tmap::tmap_save(interactive_map, 
                  interactive_filename, 
                  selfcontained = FALSE)
    
    # Reset tmap mode
    tmap::tmap_mode(tmap_mode)
  }
  
  # Return the list of maps
  return(all_maps)
}

# Helper function to inspect the structure of all_simulations
inspect_simulation_structure <- function(all_simulations, outcomes) {
  cat("Structure of all_simulations:\n")
  cat("Class:", class(all_simulations), "\n")
  cat("Length:", length(all_simulations), "\n")
  
  if (length(all_simulations) == 0) {
    cat("all_simulations is empty\n")
    return(FALSE)
  }
  
  # Check the first simulation to understand the structure
  first_sim <- all_simulations[[1]]
  cat("\nStructure of first simulation dataframe:\n")
  cat("Dimensions:", nrow(first_sim), "rows,", ncol(first_sim), "columns\n")
  cat("Column names:", paste(colnames(first_sim), collapse=", "), "\n")
  
  # Check if expected outcome columns exist
  outcome_cols <- paste0("sim_prev_abs_change_", outcomes)
  found_outcomes <- outcome_cols[outcome_cols %in% colnames(first_sim)]
  missing_outcomes <- outcome_cols[!outcome_cols %in% colnames(first_sim)]
  
  cat("\nOutcome columns found:", paste(found_outcomes, collapse=", "), "\n")
  if (length(missing_outcomes) > 0) {
    cat("Outcome columns not found:", paste(missing_outcomes, collapse=", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Check sample values for found outcomes
  if (length(found_outcomes) > 0) {
    cat("\nSample values for first found outcome:", found_outcomes[1], "\n")
    cat(paste(head(first_sim[[found_outcomes[1]]]), collapse=", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # Check if tractid column exists
  if ("tractid" %in% colnames(first_sim)) {
    cat("\nSample tractid values:", paste(head(first_sim$tractid), collapse=", "), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("\nWARNING: No 'tractid' column found in simulation dataframes\n")
  }
  
  return(TRUE)
}

# Usage example:
# First inspect the structure of your all_simulations object
inspect_simulation_structure(all_simulations, outcomes)

# Now run the generate_nyc_residual_maps function
maps <- generate_nyc_residual_maps(
  nyc_tracts = nyc_tracts,
  all_simulations = all_simulations,
  outcomes = outcomes,
  geoid_col_tracts = "GEOID",
  save_dir = "./improved_residual_maps"
)
```

```{r}
# Custom function to generate spatial residual maps for NYC with combined health outcomes
generate_nyc_combined_residual_map <- function(nyc_tracts, 
                                              all_simulations, 
                                              outcomes,
                                              geoid_col_tracts = "GEOID",
                                              save_dir = "./improved_residual_maps") {
  
  # Create the save directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {
    dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Ensure proper CRS for nyc_tracts
  if (is.na(sf::st_crs(nyc_tracts))) {
    nyc_tracts <- sf::st_set_crs(nyc_tracts, 4326)
  }
  
  # Transform to WGS84 for consistent mapping
  nyc_tracts <- sf::st_transform(nyc_tracts, 4326)
  
  # Create a data structure to store standardized residuals for all outcomes
  all_std_residuals <- list()
  
  # Get a global max/min to create consistent breaks across all outcomes
  global_min_std <- Inf
  global_max_std <- -Inf
  
  # Loop through each outcome to calculate standardized residuals
  for (outcome in outcomes) {
    cat("Processing outcome:", outcome, "\n")
    
    # Construct full column names for observed and expected values
    observed_col <- paste0("sim_prev_abs_change_", outcome)
    expected_col <- paste0("expected_", outcome)  # Adjust if your expected column naming is different
    
    # Check if the expected columns exist in the first dataframe (assuming all have same structure)
    if (length(all_simulations) > 0) {
      first_df <- all_simulations[[1]]
      
      if (!(observed_col %in% colnames(first_df))) {
        warning("Observed column ", observed_col, " not found in simulation dataframes. Skipping.")
        next
      }
      
      # For expected, we'll either use the expected_* column if it exists, or calculate the mean across simulations
      has_expected_col <- expected_col %in% colnames(first_df)
      if (!has_expected_col) {
        cat("Expected column not found. Will calculate mean across all simulations.\n")
      }
    } else {
      warning("all_simulations is empty. Skipping.")
      next
    }
    
    # Extract tractids from the first dataframe
    tractids <- first_df$tractid
    
    # Create aggregation dataframe with tractid
    agg_data <- data.frame(tractid = tractids)
    
    # Extract observed values from each simulation for this outcome
    observed_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(tractids), ncol = length(all_simulations))
    
    for (i in 1:length(all_simulations)) {
      sim_df <- all_simulations[[i]]
      
      # Match tractids to ensure correct alignment
      idx <- match(tractids, sim_df$tractid)
      
      # Extract values for this outcome
      observed_values[, i] <- sim_df[idx, observed_col]
    }
    
    # Calculate mean observed value across all simulations for each tract
    agg_data$observed <- rowMeans(observed_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Get or calculate expected values
    if (has_expected_col) {
      # If expected column exists, use it from the first simulation
      agg_data$expected <- first_df[match(tractids, first_df$tractid), expected_col]
    } else {
      # Otherwise, calculate the global mean as the expected value
      agg_data$expected <- mean(agg_data$observed, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Calculate residuals
    agg_data$residual <- agg_data$observed - agg_data$expected
    
    # Check for NAs in residuals
    if (any(is.na(agg_data$residual))) {
      cat("Warning: NAs found in residuals. Count:", sum(is.na(agg_data$residual)), "\n")
    }
    
    # Create a mapping between tractid and GEOID if needed
    if (geoid_col_tracts != "tractid" && !("tractid" %in% colnames(nyc_tracts))) {
      cat("Creating temporary 'tractid' column from", geoid_col_tracts, "for joining\n")
      nyc_tracts$tractid <- nyc_tracts[[geoid_col_tracts]]
    }
    
    # Create a temporary copy of nyc_tracts for this outcome
    map_data <- nyc_tracts
    
    # Join with agg_data to get residuals
    if ("tractid" %in% colnames(map_data)) {
      map_data$residual <- NA # Initialize with NA
      map_data$residual[match(agg_data$tractid, map_data$tractid)] <- agg_data$residual
    } else {
      # Join based on geoid_col_tracts matching tractid in agg_data
      map_data$residual <- NA # Initialize with NA
      map_data$residual[match(agg_data$tractid, map_data[[geoid_col_tracts]])] <- agg_data$residual
    }
    
    # Print summary after joining to check for NAs
    cat("Summary of residuals after joining:\n")
    print(summary(map_data$residual))
    
    # Skip this outcome if all residuals are NA
    if (all(is.na(map_data$residual))) {
      warning("All residuals are NA for outcome ", outcome, ". Skipping.")
      next
    }
    
    # Calculate standardized residuals (z-scores)
    map_data$std_residual <- (map_data$residual - mean(map_data$residual, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                             sd(map_data$residual, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Store the standardized residuals for this outcome
    map_data$outcome <- outcome  # Add outcome as a column
    all_std_residuals[[outcome]] <- map_data
    
    # Update global min/max for standardized residuals
    outcome_min <- min(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
    outcome_max <- max(map_data$std_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (outcome_min < global_min_std) global_min_std <- outcome_min
    if (outcome_max > global_max_std) global_max_std <- outcome_max
  }
  
  # If no outcomes were processed successfully, return NULL
  if (length(all_std_residuals) == 0) {
    warning("No outcomes were processed successfully. Returning NULL.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Round the global min/max to create nice breaks
  global_min_std <- floor(global_min_std)
  global_max_std <- ceiling(global_max_std)
  
  # MODIFIED: Create breaks where middle two brackets are within 2 standard deviations
  # Instead of evenly distributed breaks, we'll set specific SD cutoffs
  breaks <- c(-Inf, -2, 0, 2, Inf)
  
  # Create labels for the categories
  sd_labels <- c("< -2 SD", "-2 to 0 SD", "0 to +2 SD", "> +2 SD")
  
  # Create new color palette with specified colors
  # From brown to teal (#a6611a #dfc27d #80cdc1 #018571)
  color_palette <- c("#fd8d3c", "#fee391", "#a6bddb", "#08519c")
  
  # Create individual maps, using the same breaks for all
  individual_maps <- list()
  
  # Create mapping of outcome codes to descriptive names
  outcome_labels <- c(
    "phlth" = "Poor physical health",
    "pinactive" = "Physical inactivity",
    "mhlth" = "Poor mental health",
    "checkup" = "Routine health checkup",
    "asthma" = "Current asthma"
  )
  
  for (outcome in names(all_std_residuals)) {
    map_data <- all_std_residuals[[outcome]]
    
    # Create categories for coloring using the global breaks
    map_data$residual_cat <- cut(map_data$std_residual, 
                               breaks = breaks,
                               labels = sd_labels,
                               include.lowest = TRUE)
    
    # Create the map
    outcome_label <- outcome_labels[outcome]
    if (is.na(outcome_label)) {
      outcome_label <- toupper(outcome)
    }
    
    title <- paste("Spatial Residuals for", outcome_label)
    
    map <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::geom_sf(data = map_data, 
                     ggplot2::aes(fill = residual_cat), 
                     color = "white", size = 0.1) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        name = "Residuals\n(Standard Deviations)", 
        values = setNames(color_palette, sd_labels),
        drop = FALSE,
        na.value = "gray80"  # Color for NA values
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = title) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank()
      ) +
      # Fix the aspect ratio to avoid stretching
      ggplot2::coord_sf(datum = NA)
    
    # Add the map to the list
    individual_maps[[outcome]] <- map
    
    # Save the individual map
    map_filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("residual_map_", outcome, ".png"))
    ggplot2::ggsave(map_filename, map, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  # Combine all map data into a single dataset for faceting
  combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_std_residuals)
  
  # Convert outcome to a factor with the desired order
  combined_data$outcome <- factor(combined_data$outcome, levels = outcomes)
  
  # Add the residual_cat column to the combined data
  combined_data$residual_cat <- cut(combined_data$std_residual, 
                                 breaks = breaks,
                                 labels = sd_labels,
                                 include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  # Create a single plot with facets for each outcome
  combined_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = combined_data, 
                   ggplot2::aes(fill = residual_cat), 
                   color = "white", size = 0.1) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Residuals\n(Standard Deviations)", 
      values = setNames(color_palette, sd_labels),
      drop = FALSE,
      na.value = "gray80"  # Color for NA values
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ outcome, 
                      ncol = ifelse(length(outcomes) <= 3, length(outcomes), 
                                  ifelse(length(outcomes) <= 6, 2, 3)),
                      labeller = ggplot2::labeller(outcome = function(x) {
                        idx <- match(x, outcomes)
                        labels <- outcome_labels[x]
                        labels <- paste0("(", letters[idx], ") ", labels)
                        return(labels)
                      })) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
      legend.key.size = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "cm"),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = ggplot2::unit(1, "lines")
    ) +
    # Fix the aspect ratio to avoid stretching while allowing the maps to be larger
    ggplot2::coord_sf(datum = NA)
  
  # Save the combined map (larger size)
  combined_filename <- file.path(save_dir, "combined_health_outcomes_map.tiff")
  ggplot2::ggsave(combined_filename, combined_plot, width = 24, height = 18, dpi = 900, bg = "white",  compression = "lzw")
  
  # Return the maps
  return(list(individual_maps = individual_maps, combined_map = combined_plot))
}

# Usage example:
maps <- generate_nyc_combined_residual_map(
  nyc_tracts = nyc_tracts,
  all_simulations = all_simulations,
  outcomes = outcomes,
  geoid_col_tracts = "GEOID",
  save_dir = "./improved_residual_maps"
)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)

# Prepare data
env_data_std <- create_env_score(env_cov_gent)

# Create clustering data
clustering_data_zscore <- data.frame(
  score_0.5 = env_data_std$score_0.5,
  env_improvement = env_data_std$env_improvement
) %>% scale()

# Perform k-means clustering with k = 3
set.seed(123)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(clustering_data_zscore, centers = 3, nstart = 25)

# Assign clusters to main data
clustered_data <- env_data_std %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster))

# Check original cluster means
cluster_means <- aggregate(clustering_data_zscore, by = list(cluster = kmeans_result$cluster), mean)
print("Original cluster means:")
print(cluster_means)

# Recode clusters so cluster 1 = no enviro gent
cluster_mapping <- c(3, 2, 1)
clustered_data <- clustered_data %>%
  mutate(original_cluster = cluster,
         cluster = as.factor(cluster_mapping[as.numeric(cluster)]))

# Convert to sf and join cluster data
gent_sf <- gent_env_hlth %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(geometry)) %>%
  st_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry", crs = 4326) %>%
  left_join(clustered_data %>% dplyr::select(GEOID10, cluster), by = c("GEOID10" = "GEOID10"))

# Load NYC boundary shapefile
nyct2010wi <- st_read("nybb.shp")

# Create combined figure
create_figure_1 <- function(data, spatial_data, nyct2010wi) {
  cluster_colors <- c("#e4c988", "#687c24", "#7e4708")
  cluster_labels <- c(
    "1" = "Cluster 1: No environmental gentrification",
    "2" = "Cluster 2: Environmental improvement",
    "3" = "Cluster 3: Environmental gentrification"
  )

  # Clip spatial data to NYC boundary
  if (st_crs(spatial_data) != st_crs(nyct2010wi)) {
    spatial_data <- st_transform(spatial_data, st_crs(nyct2010wi))
  }
  nyc_boundary <- st_union(nyct2010wi)
  spatial_data <- st_intersection(spatial_data, nyc_boundary)

  # Define bounding box and missing areas
  missing_data <- spatial_data %>% filter(is.na(cluster))
  data_exists <- spatial_data %>% filter(!is.na(cluster))
  buffered_data_bbox <- st_bbox(data_exists) + c(-0.01, -0.01, 0.01, 0.01)

  # Plot (a): Scatterplot
  p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = env_improvement, y = score_0.5, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, labels = cluster_labels, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "(a) K-means Clustering Results",
    x = "Environmental Improvement Score",
    y = "Gentrification Score"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9)  # Set higher alpha for legend points
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),  # Decrease legend text size to fit on one line
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10)
  )


  # Plot (b): Spatial map with filled polygons but no legend
  p2 <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = nyc_boundary, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = missing_data, fill = "#F0F0F0", color = "grey", size = 0.1) +
    geom_sf(
      data = spatial_data %>% filter(!is.na(cluster)),
      aes(fill = cluster),
      color = "grey", linewidth = 0.1
    ) +
    geom_sf(data = nyct2010wi, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, guide = "none") + # Remove fill legend
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(buffered_data_bbox["xmin"], buffered_data_bbox["xmax"]),
      ylim = c(buffered_data_bbox["ymin"], buffered_data_bbox["ymax"])
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "(b) Spatial Distribution of Clusters"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",  # No legend for this plot
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#DDDDDD", size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#EEEEEE", size = 0.1),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10)
    )

  # Combine plots with only p1's legend
  combined_plot <- (p1 / p2) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

  return(combined_plot)
}

# Generate the figure
figure_1 <- create_figure_1(clustered_data, gent_sf, nyct2010wi)

# Save the figure as a TIFF
ggsave(
  "cluster_visualizations/figure_1_kmeans_vertical_layout.tiff",
  figure_1,
  width = 10, height = 12,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  limitsize = FALSE
)

# Display the figure
print(figure_1)
```
